name: Table frontal
material: silk (textile); gold thread; silk thread; cotton thread
dimensions: Height 1055 mm; Width 1820 mm; Height 980 mm
summary: This embroidery was suspended around a table, covering its legs. These frontals orginally decorated tables in temple spaces and home altars, but they became a common feature in the reception rooms of the wealthy.
